title: Console: Usage Insights route/model breakdown table UI (filters + drilldowns)
author: Nora Ahmed
body:
## Summary
Implements the first end-to-end console UI for the Usage Insights breakdown view (Route × Model) with filter state, drill-down navigation, loading/error/empty states, and basic table UX.

This PR is intentionally scoped to the interactive breakdown table + related page chrome. It assumes the query API exists (see pr-23135) and wires up the request/response to the UI. Export and Top Drivers are handled in separate PRs.

## User-facing behavior
- New Console section: **Usage → Cost Insights (Beta)** → **Breakdown**.
- Table supports:
  - Time range (7d / 30d / custom)
  - Project/workspace selector (existing Console control)
  - Deployment mode (Hosted/Dedicated/Private) when available
  - Region filter when available
  - Route (normalized) and Model (family/version bucket) filters
- Drilldowns:
  - Clicking a row navigates to a detail view pre-filtered to that route+model combination (keeps time range + project).
  - Breadcrumb and "Back to breakdown" preserves filter state.
- Empty states:
  - No data for time range (shows empty illustration + CTA to expand time range)
  - No permission (cost hidden via workspace setting / RBAC) shows gated copy + link to admin docs
  - Partial data banner is NOT included here (coming in pr-23170)
- Loading states:
  - Skeleton rows while query in-flight
  - Retry button on transient errors

## Implementation details
- Adds `UsageInsightsBreakdownPage` and `BreakdownTable` components.
- Centralizes filter state in URL query params to allow:
  - shareable links (within the console session)
  - consistent back/forward navigation
- Query layer:
  - Uses `useConsoleQuery()` + react-query keyed by normalized filter object.
  - Adds client-side guardrails to prevent accidental expensive queries:
    - max 30 days for interactive view (shows inline guidance when exceeded)
    - caps page size to 100
- Table:
  - Column set: Route, Model, Requests, Tokens In, Tokens Out, Cache Hit %, Avg Latency, Cost
  - Sorting: cost desc default; click-to-sort supported for most numeric columns.
  - Pagination: cursor-based; UI shows "Next" / "Previous".

## API expectations (from backend)
- Uses `GET /console/usage-insights/v1/breakdown`.
- Expects `totals` and `rows` with `next_cursor`.
- Handles `currency` from response for formatting.

## Screenshots
- Added to PR comments (see thread on 2026-02-10). Includes: normal state, empty state, and permission-gated state.

## Test plan
- Unit:
  - filter serialization/deserialization
  - table sorting state → request params
  - empty state rendering paths
- Manual:
  - Verified on `staging` with beta allowlisted workspace
  - Checked back/forward nav preserves filters
  - Verified drilldown URLs copy/paste and open with same state

## Rollout
- Behind existing feature flag: `console.usage_insights_beta` (enablement in ENG-3825).

## Follow-ups
- Data freshness banner + freshness timestamp rendering (pr-23170 / ENG-3824)
- Export button + async export flow (pr-23148 / ENG-3816)
- Top cost drivers cards (pr-23153 / ENG-3819)

## Commits (squash summary)
- console/usage-insights: add breakdown page route + nav entry
- console/usage-insights: implement BreakdownTable with sorting/pagination
- console/usage-insights: URL-backed filters + shared filter components
- console/usage-insights: empty/error/loading states + permission gating copy
- console/usage-insights: add unit tests for filter parsing and table params

## Changed areas
- apps/console/src/routes/usage/usageInsights.tsx
- apps/console/src/features/usage-insights/BreakdownPage.tsx
- apps/console/src/features/usage-insights/components/BreakdownTable.tsx
- apps/console/src/features/usage-insights/components/UsageInsightsFilters.tsx
- apps/console/src/lib/urlState/useUrlState.ts
- apps/console/src/api/usageInsights.ts
- apps/console/src/features/usage-insights/__tests__/filters.test.ts

## Notable snippet (filter state → request params)
`const params = { start_time: range.start.toISOString(), end_time: range.end.toISOString(), project_id, route: filters.route ?? undefined, model: filters.model ?? undefined, deployment_mode: filters.deploymentMode ?? undefined, region: filters.region ?? undefined, cursor, limit: 100, sort: sortKey, direction: sortDir }`

---

### Review notes / conversation highlights
- Dylan Brooks: Requested aligning empty-state wording with DevEx terminology ("endpoint" vs "route").
  - Nora Ahmed: Updated copy to say "API route (endpoint)" and added tooltip linking to docs glossary.
- Tessa Morgan: Asked to reduce clutter in filter bar at narrow widths.
  - Nora Ahmed: Implemented responsive collapse into "More filters" popover under 960px.
- Chloe Martin: Asked to ensure query keys are stable and don’t blow react-query cache.
  - Nora Ahmed: Added `stableStringifyFilters()` and normalized empty strings/undefined.
- Alex Martinez: Requested tooltips for Cache Hit % and Tokens Out definitions.
  - Nora Ahmed: Added tooltips + links to planned help-center article.

Merged after approvals and final staging verification.
